data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after one of your **NECRONS MONSTER** models is **destroyed**, before its [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise) roll is made.

**Target:** That **NECRONS MONSTER** model, which this Stratagem can target although it is **destroyed**.

**Effect:** The [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise) ability of the model deals its [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) whenever the D6 shows 3+, not only on a 6, for the rest of the phase.

window.event: after friendly model destroyed and before Deadly Demise roll
